question: How often can a user request a magic link, and how long does the link stay valid?
expected_answer: By default a user can request a magic link once every 60 seconds, and it expires after 1 hour.

question: How do I stop signInWithOtp from automatically creating a new user?
expected_answer: Set the shouldCreateUser option to false; by default users who haven't signed up are signed up automatically.

question: How many emails per hour can the default built-in email service send?
expected_answer: The default email service is limited to 2 emails per hour (best-effort, can change without notice); set up custom SMTP for production.

question: Without custom SMTP, which email addresses will Supabase Auth actually send emails to?
expected_answer: Only the email addresses of the project's organization team members; other addresses fail with 'Email address not authorized' (email_address_not_authorized).

question: What error does Supabase Auth return when a rate limit is exceeded?
expected_answer: A 429 Too Many Requests error.

question: My server calls Supabase Auth for all users and keeps hitting IP rate limits. How do I rate limit by the end user's IP instead?
expected_answer: Enable IP Address Forwarding in Authentication > Rate Limits, then send the end-user IP in the Sb-Forwarded-For header using a secret API key (publishable/legacy anon and service_role keys are not supported).

question: What is the default expiry time for access tokens (JWTs)?
expected_answer: 1 hour by default; most apps should keep it. It can be changed in Auth settings > Sessions; values below 5 minutes are discouraged.

question: Do refresh tokens expire?
expected_answer: Refresh tokens never expire, but each can be used only once (exchanged once for a new access/refresh pair), with a 10-second reuse interval exception by default.

question: How can I make sure each user has only one active session at a time?
expected_answer: Enable the 'Single session per user' option in the Auth settings (Sessions); the most recent sign-in stays active and the others are terminated.

question: What does supabase.auth.signOut() do by default in JavaScript?
expected_answer: It uses the global scope, which terminates all of the user's active sessions; use scope 'local' to end only the current session (Dart and Kotlin default to local).

question: After a user signs out, does their access token stop working immediately?
expected_answer: No. Access tokens of revoked sessions stay valid until they expire (the exp claim); the user is only logged out when the access token expires.

question: How long is the auth code valid in the PKCE flow?
expected_answer: 5 minutes, and it can be exchanged for an access token only once; the exchange must happen on the same browser/device where the flow started.

question: What minimum password length does Supabase recommend?
expected_answer: Set a large minimum length; anything less than 8 characters is not recommended. You can also require digits, lowercase, uppercase and symbols.

question: Which plan do I need for leaked password protection?
expected_answer: Leaked password protection is available on the Pro Plan and above.

question: Do users have to confirm their email before signing in on a hosted Supabase project?
expected_answer: Yes, on hosted projects email confirmation is required by default; on self-hosted or local development it is off by default.

question: How long is a TOTP MFA code valid?
expected_answer: Each TOTP code is valid for one 30-second interval, with a one-interval clock skew allowed.

question: How long is a phone MFA code valid?
expected_answer: Each phone MFA code is valid for up to 5 minutes; successive codes stay valid until expiry. Use a code length of at least 6.

question: What are the timeouts for Postgres hooks and HTTP hooks?
expected_answer: Postgres hooks have 2 seconds; HTTP hooks should complete within 5 seconds.

question: Will an HTTP auth hook be retried if my endpoint returns an error?
expected_answer: Yes for retry-able errors such as 429 or 503: up to three retries with a two-second back-off, within a 5-second total budget. Postgres hook errors are not retry-able.

question: How many custom OAuth/OIDC providers can I add on the Free plan?
expected_answer: Up to 3 custom providers on the Free plan; Pro plan and above are unlimited.

question: Is SAML SSO enabled by default on a new project?
expected_answer: No. SAML 2.0 support is disabled by default; enable it on the Auth Providers page.

question: Does Supabase Auth support SAML Single Logout (SLO)?
expected_answer: No, SLO is not supported at this time; consider session timebox or inactivity timeout instead.

question: How can my RLS policies tell anonymous users apart from permanent users?
expected_answer: Anonymous users use the authenticated role, so check the is_anonymous claim in the user's JWT in your RLS policies.

question: How do I protect the anonymous sign-in endpoint from abuse?
expected_answer: Enable invisible CAPTCHA or Cloudflare Turnstile (strongly recommended); there is also an IP-based rate limit on anonymous sign-ins (30 per hour by default).

question: Which CAPTCHA providers does Supabase Auth support?
expected_answer: hCaptcha and Cloudflare Turnstile.

question: Why does deleting a user fail?
expected_answer: You cannot delete a user who is the owner of any objects in Supabase Storage.

question: I invite a user with a redirectTo URL but the link goes to my Site URL instead. Why?
expected_answer: The redirectTo URL must be in the allowed redirect URLs; if it isn't, it's ignored and the invite redirects to the Site URL with no error.

question: Which package should I use for a Next.js app that keeps the session in cookies?
expected_answer: @supabase/ssr (cookie-based sessions with refresh-token rotation).

question: How do I test auth emails locally without hitting email limits?
expected_answer: The Supabase CLI sends all local Auth emails to Mailpit (http://127.0.0.1:54324 by default); no email leaves the machine and there is no hourly email limit locally.

question: How long are sessions kept after they expire due to a timebox or inactivity timeout?
expected_answer: They are not terminated proactively; they are cleaned up progressively 24 hours after reaching that status.

question: What is the default rate limit for SMS messages, and how much does each SMS cost?
expected_answer: Default is 30 SMS messages per hour (customizable). The per-SMS cost is not in these docs (it depends on the SMS provider).

question: Is leaked password protection available on the Free plan, and how much does the Pro plan cost per month?
expected_answer: Leaked password protection is available on the Pro Plan and above (not Free). The Pro plan's monthly price is not stated in these docs.

question: What is the default JWT expiry, and what uptime SLA does Supabase Auth guarantee?
expected_answer: The default access token expiry is 1 hour. An uptime SLA for Auth is not stated in these docs (they only say the default SMTP service has no SLA).

question: Can I send phone OTPs over WhatsApp, and in which countries does that work?
expected_answer: WhatsApp is supported as a channel only with the Twilio and Twilio Verify providers. Country availability is not covered in these docs.

question: How do I turn on CAPTCHA for sign-ups, and can I use Google reCAPTCHA?
expected_answer: Enable CAPTCHA protection under Authentication > Bot and Abuse Protection, choose the provider and enter the secret key. Only hCaptcha and Cloudflare Turnstile are documented; reCAPTCHA is not covered.

question: How many custom OAuth providers can I add on the Free plan, and how many monthly active users does the Free plan include?
expected_answer: Up to 3 custom providers on Free (unlimited on Pro+). The Free plan MAU quota is not stated in these docs.

question: Where are auth audit logs stored, and how long are they retained?
expected_answer: Audit logs go to external log storage viewable in the dashboard, and optionally to the auth.audit_log_entries Postgres table. The retention period is not stated in these docs.

question: How do I sign a user out of all their devices, and how do I notify them with a push notification when that happens?
expected_answer: Call signOut() with the global scope (the default in JavaScript) to terminate all sessions. Sending push notifications is not covered in these docs.

question: How long is a TOTP code valid, and can I change the TOTP interval to 60 seconds?
expected_answer: Each TOTP code is valid for one 30-second interval with one interval of clock skew. The docs do not describe changing the interval.

question: Is SAML SSO supported for multiple tenants, and does it work with SCIM user provisioning?
expected_answer: Yes, multi-tenant SSO with SAML 2.0 is supported, with multiple connections set up via the Supabase CLI. SCIM provisioning is not covered in these docs.
